name: The Manifold — Spire Private Betting Consortium
description: The Manifold is an invitation-only betting consortium operating from a rotating series of private Spire venues, offering bespoke wagers on events that licensed platforms cannot legally book — political assassination odds, corponation hostile takeover timelines, individual life expectancy markets, and structured neural poker tournaments where BCI bluffing-suppression is prohibited by house rules. Membership requires sponsorship by two existing members and a Φ250,000 initiation deposit. The Manifold has no fixed address, no registered corporate identity, and is believed to process in excess of Φ800 million annually through a network of compliant financial intermediaries.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 data analyst receives a Manifold invitation through a clerical error and must decide how far to go before someone realizes the mistake.
A character is hired to investigate whether a Manifold life expectancy position on their client was placed before or after a recent attempt on their client's life.
Someone inside the Manifold is leaking bet records to a journalist — not for money, but because one specific wager has convinced them something catastrophic is being planned.
